export default "---\ntitle: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)\ndescription: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance plugin — screen reader announcements, skip navigation, high-contrast support, and keyboard enhancements.\n---\n\n# Accessibility Plugin (WCAG 2.1 AA)\n\n`@gridstorm/plugin-a11y` adds a complete WCAG 2.1 AA compliance layer on top of the DOM renderer's existing ARIA attributes. It provides live screen reader announcements, skip navigation links, high-contrast CSS, and keyboard enhancements for column headers.\n\n:::tip\nThis plugin is a **legal differentiator** — WCAG 2.1 AA compliance is now a contractual requirement in government and healthcare procurement. ADA lawsuits average $20K–$50K to settle.\n:::\n\n## Installation\n\n```bash\nnpm install @gridstorm/plugin-a11y\n```\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```typescript\nimport { createGrid } from '@gridstorm/core';\nimport { A11yPlugin } from '@gridstorm/plugin-a11y';\n\nconst grid = createGrid({\n  columns: [/* ... */],\n  rowData: [/* ... */],\n  plugins: [\n    A11yPlugin({\n      announcements: true,\n      skipNav: true,\n      highContrast: true,\n    }),\n  ],\n});\n```\n\n## What it adds\n\nThe GridStorm DOM renderer already provides the structural ARIA foundation:\n\n- `role=\"grid\"`, `role=\"row\"`, `role=\"gridcell\"`, `role=\"columnheader\"`\n- `aria-rowcount`, `aria-colcount`, `aria-sort`, `aria-rowindex`, `aria-colindex`\n- `aria-selected`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-readonly`\n\nThis plugin adds the **behavioral accessibility layer**:\n\n| Feature | Description |\n|---|---|\n| Screen reader announcements | Sort changes, filter changes, selection counts, cell editing, pagination, group expand/collapse |\n| Skip navigation | Two visually-hidden links: \"Skip to grid content\" and \"Skip past grid\" |\n| High-contrast CSS | `@media (prefers-contrast: more)` and `@media (forced-colors: active)` support |\n| Header keyboard | `Enter` to sort column headers, `tabindex` management |\n| Focus mode tracking | Tracks `navigate` vs `edit` mode for correct keyboard behaviour |\n\n## Options\n\n```typescript\ninterface A11yPluginOptions {\n  /** Enable screen reader announcements via aria-live region. Default: true */\n  announcements?: boolean;\n\n  /** Inject skip navigation links before the grid. Default: true */\n  skipNav?: boolean;\n\n  /** Inject high-contrast CSS media queries. Default: true */\n  highContrast?: boolean;\n\n  /** Debounce announcement delay in ms. Default: 150 */\n  announceDebounce?: number;\n\n  /** Politeness level for announcements. Default: 'polite' */\n  politeness?: 'polite' | 'assertive';\n\n  /** Custom announcement formatter — return null to suppress */\n  formatAnnouncement?: (type: AnnouncementType, context: AnnouncementContext) => string | null;\n}\n```\n\n## Announcement Types\n\nThe plugin listens to these grid events and generates plain-language announcements:\n\n| Event | Example Announcement |\n|---|---|\n| `column:sort:changed` | \"Sorted by Name ascending\" |\n| `filter:changed` | \"Filter applied on City\" |\n| `selection:changed` | \"3 rows selected\" |\n| `cell:editingStarted` | \"Editing cell in column Age, row 5\" |\n| `cell:editingStopped` | \"Finished editing cell in column Age\" |\n| `row:groupOpened` | \"Group Electronics expanded\" |\n| `pagination:changed` | \"Page 2 of 10\" |\n| `rowData:changed` | \"500 rows loaded\" |\n\n## Custom Announcements\n\nOverride any announcement with your own text:\n\n```typescript\nA11yPlugin({\n  formatAnnouncement(type, ctx) {\n    if (type === 'selection-changed') {\n      return ctx.count === 0\n        ? 'No rows selected'\n        : `${ctx.count} ${ctx.count === 1 ? 'record' : 'records'} selected`;\n    }\n    return null; // use default for everything else\n  },\n})\n```\n\n## Commands\n\nDispatch manually from your application code:\n\n```typescript\n// Manual screen reader announcement\ngrid.commandBus.dispatch('a11y:announce', { message: 'Export complete — 250 rows saved.' });\n\n// Switch focus mode programmatically\ngrid.commandBus.dispatch('a11y:setMode', { mode: 'edit' });\n\n// Toggle high contrast overlay\ngrid.commandBus.dispatch('a11y:toggleHighContrast', {});\n```\n\n## Skip Navigation\n\nTwo visually-hidden links are injected immediately before the grid root:\n\n- **Skip to grid content** — focuses the first `[role=\"gridcell\"]`\n- **Skip past grid** — focuses the next focusable element after the grid\n\nBoth links become visible (floating badge in the top-left corner) when focused via keyboard.\n\n## High-Contrast Support\n\nThe plugin injects a `<style>` element with two media queries:\n\n```css\n@media (prefers-contrast: more) {\n  /* Solid borders, high-contrast focus rings, accessible selection colours */\n}\n\n@media (forced-colors: active) {\n  /* Windows High Contrast Mode — uses system colour keywords */\n  /* Uses ButtonText, Highlight, HighlightText instead of custom colours */\n}\n```\n\n:::caution\nAvoid using `box-shadow` for focus indicators — it disappears in forced-colors mode. The plugin enforces `outline` instead.\n:::\n\n## Plugin State\n\nAccess the plugin's runtime state:\n\n```typescript\nconst state = grid.store.getState().pluginState['a11y'];\n// {\n//   announcementsEnabled: boolean,\n//   highContrastActive: boolean,\n//   lastAnnouncement: string,\n//   focusMode: 'navigate' | 'edit',\n// }\n```\n\n## WCAG 2.1 AA Checklist\n\n| Criterion | Status | How |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | ✅ | `role=\"grid/row/gridcell/columnheader\"` |\n| 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) | ✅ | CSS tokens pass AA contrast ratios |\n| 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast | ✅ | Focus rings ≥ 3:1 |\n| 2.1.1 Keyboard | ✅ | Arrow keys, Tab, Enter, Escape |\n| 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap | ✅ | Skip-past-grid link |\n| 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks | ✅ | Skip navigation links |\n| 2.4.3 Focus Order | ✅ | Roving `tabindex` pattern |\n| 2.4.7 Focus Visible | ✅ | Always-on focus ring |\n| 3.2.2 On Input | ✅ | No unexpected context changes |\n| 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value | ✅ | ARIA labels on all interactive elements |\n| 4.1.3 Status Messages | ✅ | `aria-live` announcements |\n\n## Compatibility\n\nWorks with all major screen readers:\n\n- **NVDA** (Windows) + Chrome/Firefox\n- **JAWS** (Windows) + Chrome/Edge\n- **VoiceOver** (macOS/iOS) + Safari\n- **TalkBack** (Android) + Chrome\n"
